title: 2025 AMC 10B Problem 18
statement: What is the ones digit of the sum \(\lfloor\sqrt{1}\rfloor + \lfloor\sqrt{2}\rfloor + \lfloor\sqrt{3}\rfloor\) \(+ \cdots + \lfloor\sqrt{2024}\rfloor\) \(+ \lfloor\sqrt{2025}\rfloor?\) (Recall that \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to \(x.\))

solutions.text: For each \(m,\) \(\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor = m\) on the \(2m + 1\) integers \(m^2 \le n \le (m + 1)^2 - 1.\) Since \(\sqrt{2025} = 45,\) the terms with \(1 \le m \le 44\) contribute \(\sum_{m=1}^{44} m(2m + 1),\) and \(n = 2025\) tacks on \(45.\) That sum is \(\sum_{m=1}^{44}(2m^2 + m)\) \(= 2 \cdot \tfrac{44 \cdot 45 \cdot 89}{6}\) \(+ \tfrac{44 \cdot 45}{2} = 58740\) \(+ 990 = 59730,\) so the total is \(59775.\) Its ones digit is \(5.\) Therefore, the answer is D.
hints: Since \(\sqrt{2025} = 45,\) sum \(m(2m + 1)\) for \(m = 1\) to \(44\) and add the final term \(45\)
